name: Gus
self_text: I am a non-binary Mexican in my early 30s. I enjoy restoring bikes in my spare time. I use a Nikon. I am free Sunday morning for a relaxed photo walk at a fast pace. I am looking for someone to teach me post-processing.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a relaxed photo walk or a practice session working on specific shots. It would be nice if you are the one who teaches me post-processing, and it's a small bonus if you are okay with a moderate pace or a fast pace.
